title: Regional climate and disaster policy demo
scope_note: Illustrative prototype. Country-level evidence scores are shown only where a reviewed sample exists. Document counts and page totals are catalog metadata, not evidence scores.
method_note: Manual representative pilot from selected pages. Not exhaustive, not model output, and not a country performance or on-track rating.

claims.score_rationale: A target is present but ambiguous. The source text is preserved, not interpreted as a precise value.

claims.statement: Urban, agriculture and tourism are assessed among Albania’s highest-risk sectors; compound and transboundary climate risks may increase the overall risk.
The NDC identifies a 2035 mitigation target and says delivery depends on full implementation and adequate financing of NECP mitigation measures.

ALB.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: The NDC reports 1.23°C observed warming (1929–2016) and projects further warming, lower precipitation, droughts and heatwaves.
Adaptation priorities include modernizing irrigation, protecting water resources, climate-resilient urban planning, flood protection and early warning.

ARM.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Belarus states an unconditional economy-wide 2035 emissions reduction of at least 42% from 1990, and a conditional 47% reduction subject to international support.
The NDC reports a very low climate-risk index for children and says child-specific needs will be considered in the adaptation action plan through 2040.

BLR.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Bosnia and Herzegovina describes high climate vulnerability and cites a third-place ranking for climate-related losses and damage in 2014.
The NDC describes projected lower seasonal water availability and quality alongside more intense runoff and flood risk.

BIH.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

CYP.source_document_title: EU and its Member States NDC

claims.statement: The EU submission describes future climate-risk policy measures on governance, risk-owner tools, structural policies and financial resilience.
claims.source_document_title: EU and its Member States NDC

claims.statement: The EU submission gives an indicative 2035 net-emissions reduction range of 66.25–72.5% from 1990, linked to its 2040 target pathway.
claims.source_document_title: EU and its Member States NDC

CYP.scope_note: EU-level NDC submission on behalf of the EU and its Member States; not a Cyprus-only plan.

claims.statement: Georgia’s adaptation goals include improving emergency response, introducing early warning and forecasting extreme events to identify vulnerable people locally.
The NDC organizes climate response around adaptation goals and sector-specific measures.

GEO.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: The NDC lists objectives to assess water-resource impacts, establish early warning, integrate climate risks into planning, modernize irrigation and strengthen drinking-water supply.
The NDC plans a green-products programme and pilot green industrial zones, with support for producer certification and carbon-footprint assessment.

KGZ.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: The NDC describes flash-flood and soil-erosion impacts on women farmers, alongside gaps in disaster insurance and financial safety nets.
Moldova’s adaptation programme through 2030 covers six priority sectors, including agriculture, health, transport and water, with a multi-objective action plan.

MDA.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Montenegro’s NDC sets a 55% GHG-emissions reduction target from 1990 levels and two implementation periods, 2025–2030 and 2031–2035.
A national climate law and MRV system are in force; a by-law enables participation in the EU emissions-trading system from 2025.

MNE.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: North Macedonia’s NDC records a 2030 CO₂ reduction commitment of 30%, or 36% under a higher-ambition scenario, against business as usual.

MKD.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Serbia’s NDC is framed for the period through 2035 and reviews prior emissions-reduction commitments.
The NDC reports that roughly 70% of electricity is generated in thermal power plants and describes high electricity use and low energy efficiency.

SRB.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Tajikistan’s adaptation strategy prioritizes energy, water, transport and agriculture and identifies adaptation measures and financing mechanisms.
The NDC describes climate-related forest-fire risk and potential flood damage to highways in vulnerable regions.

TJK.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Türkiye’s NDC states a net-zero emissions ambition for 2053 and an economy-wide mitigation contribution.
The NDC links climate action to sector plans for water, agriculture, energy efficiency and transport, and identifies women, children and low-income communities for inclusion.

TUR.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Turkmenistan reports 1.4°C observed warming over 55 years and expects further warming, reduced precipitation and more severe hydrometeorological events.
The NDC identifies agriculture, water, health, land, ecosystems and forestry as vulnerable sectors and proposes sectoral adaptation measures.

TKM.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Ukraine’s in-force adaptation strategy runs through 2030; the NDC says a new climate-adaptation strategy is planned for development and approval.
The NDC describes flood, coastal-flood, drought and other extreme-weather risks affecting people, ecosystems, agriculture and infrastructure.

UKR.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.

claims.statement: Uzbekistan reports expanded sectoral and regional adaptation planning, coordinating institutions, financing mechanisms and an adaptation module for its MRV platform.
The NDC commits to worker retraining and skills support to help workers move into growing sectors during economic and technological transition.

UZB.scope_note: Selected-page sample; document-wide coverage is not implied.
